==Events==
The [[Galactic Exploitation Technologies]] led by two [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, the criminals [[Marvid Qreph]] and [[Craitheus Qreph]], tried a hostile takeover of the entire galactic economy but were defeated by the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]].<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>
